headline: 每日深读｜2026-10-04：5项值得追踪的进展
lead: 本期从过去24小时的12项合格候选中，选取5项有来源的报道，按具体进展展开。

chapters.title: ESA to pursue crew transport and space stations as European launchers come online
chapters.angle: 追踪本次报道中的具体变化

blocks.text: Illustration of The Exploration Company’s Nyx capsule approaching the ISS. (Credit: The Exploration Company) European crew transport Preparing for the decommissioning of the International Space Station (ISS), currently scheduled to begin in 2030, ESA and other ISS partners are working to ensure sustained access to low-Earth orbit. Ultimately, ESA wants a European version of all capabilities required for human spaceflight, including not only rockets and a crew vehicle but also a launch abort system, space operations, science, and crew recovery.

displayTranslation.text: 为准备目前计划于2030年开始的国际空间站（ISS）退役，ESA与其他ISS伙伴正努力确保对低地球轨道的持续进入。ESA设想为Nyx太空舱接近ISS的场景，并希望最终拥有欧洲版人类航天所需的全部能力，不仅包括火箭和乘员飞船，还包括发射中止系统、太空操作、科学和乘员回收。

chapters.title: U.S. Navy Commissions Flight III Destroyer USS Ted Stevens (DDG 128) in Alaska
chapters.angle: 追踪本次报道中的具体变化

blocks.text: Navy has officially commissioned the USS Ted Stevens (DDG 128), its newest Flight III Arleigh Burke-class guided-missile destroyer equipped with the SPY-6 radar and Aegis Baseline 10, during a ceremony in Whittier, Alaska.

displayTranslation.text: 美国海军已在阿拉斯加惠蒂尔举行的仪式上正式服役USS Ted Stevens（DDG 128），这是其最新的Flight III阿利·伯克级导弹驱逐舰，装备SPY-6雷达和Aegis Baseline 10。

blocks.text: US Navy press release The U.S. Navy placed its newest Flight III Arleigh Burke-class guided-missile destroyer, USS Ted Stevens (DDG 128), into active commission today during a formal ceremony in Whittier, Alaska.

displayTranslation.sourceText: US Navy press release The U.S. Navy placed its newest Flight III Arleigh Burke-class guided-missile destroyer, USS Ted Stevens (DDG 128), into active commission today during a formal ceremony in Whittier, Alaska.

blocks.text: As the second Flight III destroyer to enter active service, USS Ted Stevens provides combatant commanders with unmatched integrated air and missile defense capabilities, directly supporting Department of War priorities to enforce maritime dominance, secure contested sea lanes, and project credible deterrence worldwide.

displayTranslation.text: 作为第二艘进入现役的Flight III驱逐舰，USS Ted Stevens为作战指挥官提供无与伦比的综合防空和导弹防御能力，直接支持战争部在 enforcing maritime dominance、确保有争议的海上航道和投射可信全球威慑方面的优先事项。
displayTranslation.sourceText: As the second Flight III destroyer to enter active service, USS Ted Stevens provides combatant commanders with unmatched integrated air and missile defense capabilities, directly supporting Department of War priorities to enforce maritime dominance, secure contested sea lanes, and project credible deterrence worldwide.

blocks.text: The commissioning of the USS Ted Stevens (DDG 128) underscores the Navy’s commitment to building America’s Golden Fleet. The commissioning of USS Ted Stevens marks an immediate, decisive leap in naval warfighting readiness and surface fleet lethality.

displayTranslation.text: USS Ted Stevens（DDG 128）的服役彰显了海军建设美国黄金舰队的承诺。USS Ted Stevens的服役标志着海军作战准备和水面舰队杀伤力的直接、决定性飞跃。

events.title: Raytheon awarded $24.4 billion multi-year contract for SM-6 interceptors
events.originalTitle: Raytheon awarded $24.4 billion multi-year contract for SM-6 interceptors
events.excerpt: Raytheon has secured a five-year contract, with two additional option years, valued up to $24.4 billion for Standard Missile-6 (SM-6) interceptors, significantly increasing the availability of a critical munition able to conduct both offensive strikes and missile defense missions. “SM-6’s multi-mission capability is vital to our customer, and Raytheon is intensely focused on meeting the demand,” said Raytheon President Phil Jasper.

evidenceRecords.text: Raytheon has secured a five-year contract, with two additional option years, valued up to $24.4 billion for Standard Missile-6 (SM-6) interceptors, significantly increasing the availability of a critical munition able to conduct both offensive strikes and missile defense missions.
“SM-6’s multi-mission capability is vital to our customer, and Raytheon is intensely focused on meeting the demand,” said Raytheon President Phil Jasper.
SM-6 is the only combat-proven weapon that can perform anti-air warfare, anti-surface warfare and ballistic missile defense.

“SM-6’s multi-mission capability is vital to our customer, and Raytheon is intensely focused on meeting the demand,” said Raytheon President Phil Jasper. “By continuously investing in our operations and facilities, we are removing constraints and boosting capacity to ensure we deliver this critical capability our sailors depend on.”
It has been successfully fired from various U.S.
Navy ship-based platforms and launchers on land, providing the fleet with a versatile and highly reliable weapon to counter the full range of kinetic threats faced by today’s naval forces.

displayTranslation.title: 雷神获244亿美元多年期合同，生产SM-6拦截弹
displayTranslation.summary: 雷神公司获得一份为期五年、另含两个选择权年的合同，价值最高达244亿美元，用于生产标准导弹-6（SM-6）拦截弹。该合同将显著提升这款关键弹药的可用性，它既能执行进攻性打击，也能执行导弹防御任务。雷神总裁菲尔·贾斯珀表示：“SM-6的多任务能力对我们的客户至关重要，雷神正全力聚焦于满足这一需求。”

events.originalTitle: Northrop Grumman’s Talon Blue Collaborative Combat Aircraft Has Flown
events.excerpt: We have a significant update on the fast-moving world of Collaborative Combat Aircraft (CCA) out of Mojave, California today. Northrop Grumman’s Talon Blue, which now has the official designation YFQ-48A, has taken to the skies for the first time. Talon Blue flying out of Mojave Air and Space Port for the first time. (@Task_Force23) TASK_FORCE23 The uncrewed aircraft took to the skies over Mojave Air and Space Port, home of famed ‘bleeding0edge’ airframer and Northrop Grumman subsidiary Scaled Composites, which built the aircraft.

evidenceRecords.text: We have a significant update on the fast-moving world of Collaborative Combat Aircraft (CCA) out of Mojave, California today.
Northrop Grumman’s Talon Blue, which now has the official designation YFQ-48A, has taken to the skies for the first time.

Talon Blue flying out of Mojave Air and Space Port for the first time. (@Task_Force23) TASK_FORCE23 The uncrewed aircraft took to the skies over Mojave Air and Space Port, home of famed ‘bleeding0edge’ airframer and Northrop Grumman subsidiary Scaled Composites, which built the aircraft.
3, 2026 – Northrop Grumman’s (NYSE: NOC) YFQ-48A Talon Blue completed its first fully autonomous flight, including taxi, takeoff, in-flight maneuvers, and landing.
The flight builds on Northrop Grumman’s seven decades of autonomy experience and more than 500,000 autonomous flight hours, with lessons from Talon Blue informing future autonomous systems.

Details on YFQ-48A Talon Blue: Talon Blue is part of Northrop Grumman’s internally-funded Project Talon portfolio focused on accelerating the development of mission-ready autonomous airpower capabilities.

Every flight and lesson strengthens our broader autonomy work and sharpens what comes next.” Talon Blue flying above the Mojave Desert in California. (Northrop Grumman) While the Talon Blue aircraft draws most of the attention, Northrop Grumman has put great emphasis on its back-end autonomy development ecosystem, which includes its purpose-built Model 437 demonstrator aircraft , now under the Talon IQ badge (formerly Beacon).

Talon Blue is entering a growing field of CCA offerings, with extremely intense competition, that are primarily aimed at equipping the USAF with its next CCA acquisition of hundreds of aircraft known as Increment 2 , for which the requirements remain undefined.

Many more types are on the horizon, including those from new players and globally from foreign manufacturers . (@Task_Force23) TASK_FORCE23 (@Task_Force23) TASK_FORCE23 With the loss of the F/A-XX next-generation naval fighter program to Boeing, Northrop Grumman winning a contract from the U.S. services for Talon Blue has become more important.
